common_scientific_definition.baseline_union_rule: every arm retains the same original feasible baseline pool and adds only newly discovered feasible coordinates
common_scientific_definition.statistical_unit: complete run; candidates are not independent repeats

A_MPGA_then_GA.A0: original per-start highest-Q feasible MPGA representative pool; no added search
A_MPGA_then_GA.A1: same baseline plus original-protocol MPG-GA accepted visits
A_MPGA_then_GA.A2: same baseline plus accepted visits from true continuation of reconstructed original terminal MPGA state
A_MPGA_then_GA.A3: same baseline plus visits from independent original-distribution MPGA starts
A_MPGA_then_GA.continuation_rule: reconstruct terminal x, gradient, objective and stop reason deterministically from original starts and frozen optimizer; verify paired endpoint identity before extension; only max-update survivors are eligible; stationary and line-search-failed starts remain stopped
A_MPGA_then_GA.new_start_atomic_unit: one independent hit-and-run start per each of 80 supports, preserving balanced support coverage; atomic units rotate the four original chain slots and four units recover the original four-chain allocation; 120 frozen MPGA updates
A_MPGA_then_GA.if_state_reconstruction_fails: do not label any alternative as continuation; report the missing state and stop A2

B_Generator_then_GA.B0: original frozen Generator candidate pool; no added search
B_Generator_then_GA.B1: same baseline plus original-protocol Generator-GA accepted visits
B_Generator_then_GA.B2: same baseline plus additional inference from the same frozen generator checkpoint, independent seed, same projection and audit, no retraining and no GA
B_Generator_then_GA.new_sampling_atomic_unit: one balanced 8,000-candidate batch, 100 candidates per support

cost_calibration.hardware: same local machine; serial execution; no competing experiment
cost_calibration.warmup: one excluded technical warmup for each computational kernel
cost_calibration.GA_anchor: dedicated no-logging 40,000-attempt replay using replicate 1 frozen inputs; MPG-GA anchors A and Generator-GA anchors B
cost_calibration.primary_budget: maximum whole predeclared atomic work units whose calibrated wall time does not exceed the route-specific GA anchor
cost_calibration.secondary_budget: when the minimum scientifically valid atomic unit exceeds the anchor, execute one full atomic unit as an explicitly over-budget feasibility/cost measurement; do not call it equal time
cost_calibration.formal_execution: fixed work counts from calibration, not wall-clock early stopping
cost_calibration.timing: generation or optimization, in-memory trajectory collection, projection and common audit are included; file serialization is excluded; CUDA kernels synchronized before and after

evaluation.fixed_selection: existing within-run/support median-Q floor, highest-Q first, then farthest scaled-coordinate rule; same quota on common supports
evaluation.cost_efficiency: increment per calibrated added cost and paired five-run differences
evaluation.final_output_comparison: all-discovered feasible pool and one-representative/final-output compression are reported separately

guardrails: no predictor training or parameter tuning
no change to GA, MPGA, generator, thresholds or elite rules
no claim of exact equal compute when calibrated wall times differ
no claim that predicted improvement is measured physical improvement
no overwrite of historical results, V41 manuscript or figures
